text:
Type: open metal and glass shelving unit
Use: displaying books, plants and decor on open shelves; living room, home office, dining room
Style: industrial, minimalist, modern
Materials: black-brown powder-coated steel frame, clear glass shelves, dark laminated bottom shelf
Colors: dark black-brown, clear glass
Shape: tall wide open grid of three joined bays in thin square tubing, several tiers of see-through glass and dark shelves, open sides and back, airy and light for its size
Feel: airy, graphic, light, urban
Goes with: light wood, white walls, green plants, leather; industrial, Scandinavian or modern living rooms and studios

product.name: VITTSJ
product.description: Tempered glass and metal are durable materials that provide an open, airy feel.
